result.line: Polygon is only the Spoke layer: deposit/repay/createLoanAndDeposit are self-service (msg.sender is the user and pays CCIP fees), config calls are role-gated (boostCapacity from a fresh address reverts 0xe2517d3f AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount), and the only permissionless ones - BridgeRouter.retryMessage/reverseMessage and BridgeRouterSpoke.withdraw on 0xf854ac65a40f1eabfd32e6d4c7d0e1c4b1753cc5 - pay a stranger 0. 7 d: 5 MessageSucceeded, 0 Withdraw; gas 0.010-0.021 USD/call (370k-790k gas at 319-329 gwei, POL 0.0818 USD); TVL 408,339 USD. liquidate/rebalance live on the Avalanche hub.
